name: Beijing Yuanliu Hongyuan Electronic Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Yuanliu Hongyuan Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of electronic components in China and internationally. The company operates through Self-Produced Business and Agency Business segments. It offers ceramic capacitors and components, filters, microprocessors, microcontrollers, microwave modules, micro-nano system integrated ceramic shells, and supporting integrated circuits. In addition, the company provides resistors, inductors, RF devices, discrete devices, connectors, integrated circuits, and other products.
